_comment: Everything the dashboard's Apply kit lets you copy. Edit any value, save, and refresh the dashboard (no restart needed). Lines starting with EDIT ME are placeholders: replace them with your real answer. This repo is public: anything you put here is visible to anyone, so keep salary numbers and your phone number out of commits.

answers.label: Where are you based?
answers.value: EDIT ME: city, province, Canada (time zone). Open to remote, hybrid or onsite in Canada, and remote roles in the US.

answers.label: Work authorization
answers.value: EDIT ME: e.g. Canadian citizen / permanent resident / work permit. For US roles: whether you need sponsorship or can work as a contractor.

answers.label: Availability / start date
answers.value: EDIT ME: e.g. Immediately / two weeks' notice

answers.label: Salary expectation
answers.value: EDIT ME: a range in CAD or USD

answers.label: Years of experience
answers.value: EDIT ME: e.g. New grad (B.Sc. Computer Science, 2026) with internship and project experience in Python, AWS and Kubernetes.

answers.label: Full-time or contract?
answers.value: EDIT ME: e.g. Looking for full-time new grad or entry-level roles.

summaries.infrastructure: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentences for infrastructure / platform / cloud roles (projects, internships, AWS, Kubernetes, Linux).
summaries.backend: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentences for Backend / Python roles (services and APIs you built, stack).
summaries.fullstack: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentences for full-stack and general software engineer roles.
